rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for “almost” or “nearly,” including approximate amounts such as nearly two hours.

example.english: I've been waiting for nigh two hours.
example.traditional: 我等咗差唔多兩個鐘喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 caa1 m4 do1 loeng5 go3 zung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something nearly happened but did not, especially in expressions like “差啲跌倒” (“almost fell”).

example.english: I came nigh to falling over just now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 caa1 di1 dit3 can1
